'''Chorlen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. He made his living by working as a vendor, selling various products to the Empire's citizens. He was of average height for a Human being and had light, tan skin.
